title: Hinomori Shiho — Important Preparations〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What did you think, Shiho?
Is it all coming together?
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we've gotten better...
But there's still a lot of room for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, you have a habit of rushing ahead during the chorus, so try to be careful and stay in rhythm with Honami's bass drum.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, got it!
I'll keep my ears open for your drumming, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You too, Ichika.
Your strumming eases up here and there when you sing during the chorus. Also, try to relax more during the part where we all sync to the same rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be careful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start again just before the chorus, right where the second verse ends...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best so that we can put on the best show we can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Our solo show's gonna be the most powerful ever!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's stop our practice run here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. We can spend the rest of our time working on the things we need to individually.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nice work, girls! That was really amazing☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, you guys!
Wait, were you listening to all that from outside?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, we wanted to talk to you after you finished playing that last song. You all performed so well that now I feel like playing myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you mind joining me for practice? This one part is giving me a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm having trouble staying in rhythm... I always end up rushing ahead during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, how about we practice together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You mean it?!
Okay, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You all sound incredibly motivated.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's a far cry from when you girls first decided that you're going to do a solo show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and you seem to be enjoying playing together much more now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
However, there's still a lot of room left for improvement, so we can't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
I'd like to keep doing everything I can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a good mindset...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you all sound much more optimistic now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have you to thank for that, Honami. We wouldn't be feeling this way if it weren't for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We know that going pro means making some sacrifices.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, we want to be the ones who decide what we actually sacrifice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that we can stay true to our feelings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: None of the questions Mr. Shindo hit us with then were easy to answer...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But you didn't hesitate.
You put Leo/need and what we stand for at the forefront.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're able to move in the same direction now because you were willing to tell him how we truly feel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You really are a cool person, Honami...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Not everyone can do what you did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I...
That time, I felt compelled to tell him how we truly feel... So I just said whatever came to mind...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: C-Can we change the subject...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! But it's such a cool story! I could tell it over and over again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. I feel that we'll be talking about it for quite a while moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You heard them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I appreciate the praise, but I feel really embarrassed at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still... Being able to say what I felt like that must mean I've become a stronger person...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've always been a strong person, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean...
Remember how you told me what was bothering you that one time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I absolutely don't want you to carry this weight by yourself! It doesn't seem right at all!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, you really deserved this credit sooner.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That happened?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right. That did happen.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that did turn into a bit of a sticky situation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You really hit me with some tough love that time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sh-Shiho, stop...
That might give some people the wrong idea!
